开发 Agent Runtime 相关模块，包括任务执行、状态管理、执行步骤编排、异步任务处理、暂停恢复、超时控制及异常处理。
开发统一模型接入与调用服务，支持多模型适配、模型路由、调用参数管理、限流、重试、Fallback 及调用记录。
开发 Agent 执行上下文、会话状态、记忆存储和知识检索等相关后端能力。
参与 Workflow、单 Agent 及多 Agent 协作功能开发，确保执行过程可追踪、异常可定位、结果可验证。
基于底层模型与 Agent 引擎能力，设计并落地上层 AI 应用，面向企业业务场景完成应用封装、业务逻辑编排与场景化能力交付。

2. Skill / Tool 执行与生态接入
开发 Skill/Tool 注册、发现、配置、调用、版本管理及执行结果处理等核心模块。
支持 MCP 等工具接入方式，实现第三方 API、企业业务系统及工业软件能力的标准化封装与调用。
负责工具调用参数校验、权限校验、超时处理、异常恢复及执行结果结构化。
配合设计工具执行隔离、凭证管理、访问控制和审计机制，保障 Agent 执行过程的安全性。
支持生态伙伴开发的 Agent、Skill 和工具接入平台，解决接口兼容、执行稳定性及版本升级问题。

3. AI 工程化与质量保障
建立并完善模型调用、Agent 执行和工具调用的日志、Tracing、指标采集及异常告警能力。
参与构建 Agent 评测与回归测试机制，验证任务完成情况、工具调用准确率、输出质量及异常处理能力。
针对生产环境中的幻觉、工具调用失败、上下文过长、模型超时等问题进行分析和优化。
优化 Prompt、上下文组装、缓存、并发调用和异步处理策略，降低推理成本与响应延迟。
编写单元测试、集成测试及自动化测试用例，确保核心模块的可靠性和可维护性。

与传统云平台 Backend 团队协作，集成统一身份认证、租户管理、权限体系、数据库、消息队列和计费服务。
配合实现 Token 使用量及 Agent 执行任务的计量数据采集，为平台商业计费、成本分析和运营管理提供技术支持。
参与 Docker、Kubernetes 等环境下的服务部署、性能测试、问题排查及生产环境运维。
遵循团队统一的代码规范、分支管理、Code Review、CI/CD 和发布流程，持续提升代码质量。
接收业务需求，基于平台架构设计，结合实际业务场景，输出可交付的软件功能 ，将平台架构设计和实际业务场景转化为可交付的软件功能。

Job Description: 
The Role and Impact 
As an AI Software Development Engineer, you will play a pivotal role in advancing on-device AI capabilities by developing and optimizing software solutions that integrate cutting-edge AI models and hardware. Your day-to-day work will include prototyping innovative AI applications, crafting inference pipelines, and enabling hardware-software collaboration to deliver impactful, scalable solutions. This position is critical in shaping AI innovations that enhance user experiences across millions of devices. 

Business group 
Intel Corporation's Client Computing Group AI and Graphics domain focuses on driving intelligent computing solutions from the cloud to end devices. By collaborating with global research and development teams and industry-leading model developers, the group tackles critical challenges in model deployment, hardware-software optimization, and multimodal AI innovation. This team's work supports Intel's mission to deliver exceptional computing experiences and pushes boundaries in AI for end devices. 

Key Responsibilities 
- Collaborate with leading model teams to deploy large language models (LLMs), vision-language models (VLMs), AI agents, and image/video generation models on end-user devices. 
- Rapidly prototype and develop inference pipelines, media codecs, and automation tools using Python or C/C++. 
- Participate in system-level hardware-software co-optimization for CPUs, GPUs, and NPUs to improve performance and engineering efficiency. 
- Engage in technical evaluations, prototyping, system integration, and iterative product development cycles. 
- Build cross-domain solutions by aligning with model, hardware, and ecosystem stakeholders to scale on-device AI capabilities.

Qualifications:
Minimum Qualifications 
- Bachelor's degree in a relevant field with 0-1 years of hands-on experience in AI software development, with demonstrated skills gained through internships, academic projects, coursework, or hands-on training OR a Master's degree in a relevant field with no prior professional experience. 
- Proficiency in Python or C/C++ and familiarity with Windows or Linux development environments. 
- Basic understanding of AI development tools and practices, including personal projects, coursework, or contributions to open-source platforms. 

Preferred Qualifications 
- Experience in developing LLMs, VLMs, AI agents, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), or tool-use workflows. 
- Knowledge of inference frameworks like PyTorch, OpenVINO, and ONNX Runtime. 
- Practical experience in model quantization, distillation, fine-tuning (e.g., LoRA), and deployment on end devices. 
- Familiarity with GPU/NPU acceleration, media processing, video codecs, and system performance optimization techniques. 
- Comfortable working with AI development workflows using tools like Cursor and GitHub Copilot. 

We welcome innovative thinkers eager to translate AI advancements into impactful solutions that reach millions of users. If you thrive in a collaborative and engineering-driven culture, this role offers unparalleled opportunities to grow and make a difference.

Job Description

岗位职责：
1、基于 ReAct / Plan-and-Execute 等范式构建 Agentic AI，通过 Prompt 设计与上下文工程，精细控制模型决策与输出行为，实现多工具调用 / 多 Agent 工作流编排（任务拆解、路由、结果汇总），设计多轮会话的流程、对话状态、记忆管理（Long-Term Memory）和 RAG 的组合优化策略，将 Agent 能力落地到生产业务中。

279.description: Role Datago turns Chinese and English financial text into structured data products: sentiment scores, named-entity recognition, event classification, used by institutional clients. The team fine-tunes BERT-family encoders on proprietary corpora, maintains rigorous evaluation standards, and builds pipelines around them. As the models are delivered to paying clients, evaluation standards are strict and all results must be auditable. This is a model development role rather than a prompt-engineering position. The work spans training loops, dataset preparation and evaluation design, and the engineer is accountable for the figures the models produce. AI assistants are in the workflow but responsibility for results remains with the engineer. Responsibilities Fine-tune and maintain encoder models (BERT, and more) for classification, NER and sentiment tasks. Design evaluation frameworks that reflect client priorities: ranking consistency, correlation against ground truth, and strict point-in-time splits. Join us to create what comes next, grow through new experiences and extend your impact across Asia.

Customer Centricity - This role contributes to the delivery of customer outcomes that are reliable, thoughtful, and create meaningful impact for customers and society. The role holder is expected to embed a customer first mindset in all decisions and actions by developing a clear understanding of customer needs, taking end to end ownership to resolve issues, and working collaboratively across teams to continuously enhance the customer journey—both directly and indirectly.

To support AIA’s mission of helping customers live healthier, longer, and better lives, the Data Scientist, AI Application will support the organisation’s Technology, Data and Analytics (TDA) transformation by contributing to the design, implementation, and adoption of AI-enabled solutions. The role will work closely with business and technology teams to understand business requirements, assist in solution design activities, and help translate business needs into practical and scalable technology solutions.

The role will assist in evaluating AI use cases, conducting research, supporting proof-of-concept activities, and helping delivery the solutions while aligning with enterprise architecture standards, security requirements, and governance guidelines.

Beyond project delivery, the role will support knowledge-sharing initiatives, maintain project and solution repositories, and contribute to continuous improvement efforts. Through collaboration with cross-functional teams, ongoing learning, and a strong focus on stakeholder engagement to drive the successful delivery and adoption of AI solutions across the organisation.

Roles And Responsibilities

Strategic AI Leadership & Innovation (30%)

Support the delivery of AI initiatives by researching emerging AI technologies, industry trends, and business use cases that may enhance operational efficiency and customer experience.
Contribute to AI program and roadmap activities by gathering requirements, documenting opportunities, and assisting with the planning and tracking of AI-related projects.
Assist in AI solution assessment and experimentation, supporting prototyping, testing, and feasibility studies under the guidance of senior team members and subject matter experts.
Collaborate with business and technology stakeholders to understand user needs, collect feedback, and help ensure AI solutions align with business objectives and operational requirements.
Promote awareness and adoption of AI capabilities by supporting knowledge-sharing activities, preparing presentations or materials, and communicating project outcomes to relevant stakeholders.
Continuously build AI and digital skills by staying informed of new technologies, best practices, and organisational standards, applying learning to support ongoing AI initiatives.



AI Solution Design, Research & Delivery (50%)

Support the design and implementation of AI solutions by assisting with requirements gathering, data analysis, solution documentation, and testing activities to address business needs.
Conduct research on AI, machine learning, and generative AI technologies, summarising findings and identifying potential applications to improve business processes and customer experiences.
Deliver proof-of-concept (POC) and prototyping activities, helping to validate solution feasibility, assess business value, and gather stakeholder feedback.
Contribute to innovation initiatives by exploring new tools, techniques, and best practices, and sharing insights with team members to support continuous improvement.
Support solution testing, validation, and deployment activities, ensuring deliverables meet business requirements and established quality standards.
Develop practical AI user cases through hands-on project experience, training, and continuous learning, applying new knowledge to support ongoing AI initiatives.



Business Communication, Stakeholder Alignment & Change Management (20%)

Act as a strategic bridge between business and technology, translating business vision into AI solution strategies and executable architecture designs.
Communicate complex AI concepts, solution architectures, and trade-offs clearly to senior stakeholders and governance forums.
Influence long-term technology direction and drive adoption of AI capabilities across AIA Group.
Act as a thought leader in AI and digital transformation, shaping innovation agendas and elevating engineering and solution design maturity across the organisation.
Demonstrates strong ownership of outcomes by proactively identifying risks, driving issue resolution, and ensuring delivery commitments are met with high quality and timeliness.



Minimum Job Requirements

Must Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree or higher in computer science, engineering, science, or related fields, or equivalent in experience and evidence of exceptional ability.
Relevant experience in AI projects delivery role
Experience in distributed system tools, such as Docker, Kubernetes, OpenShift, Redis, Kafka, etc.
Hands on project experience in generative AI tech stack
Customer focus to understand customer pain points and deliver value add tech solution to customers
Good team player
Strong communication skills in English, Mandarin, or Cantonese



Preferred Qualifications

Experience in DevOps, ML Ops and LLM Ops.
Experience in Agile/Scrum software development process.

Bachelor's degree or above; Computer Science or AI-related major preferred
1–5 years of professional experience
Solid foundation in at least one backend language: Java or Golang
Proficiency in Node.js and React
Experience owning end-to-end projects in production — not just personal side projects
Familiarity with database design, data modeling, and core backend concepts
Highly proficient with mainstream AI coding tools (Cursor, Copilot, Claude Code, or similar)
Ability to clearly articulate requirements and constraints to AI tools; strong enough fundamentals to review, validate, and correct AI-generated code

Product and operational mindset — you can turn vague ideas into clear specs
Curious observer — you pay attention to how other teams work and actively suggest improvements
Strong logical thinking and communication skills; passionate about learning new technologies

Open-source contributions or notable GitHub projects
Cross-platform development experience (iOS/Android/Web)

Shape the future of finance

522.description:
Capco

Capco is a leading global technology and management consultancy that excels in driving digital transformation within the financial services and insurance sectors. With an unwavering commitment to delivering practical solutions, we empower our clients to navigate the complexities of today's fast-paced market. Our integrated services span across major financial hubs worldwide, ensuring that we are always close to our clients and their needs.

At Capco, we possess not only the expertise but also the vision and passion necessary to lead transformative change. As we embark on an exciting growth journey, this is the perfect moment to join our team. We are expanding geographically, increasing our workforce, and poised to disrupt the consulting landscape across APAC with our entrepreneurial spirit and agile methodologies.

About The Role

We are thrilled to introduce an opportunity for a talented AI Engineer to join our Hong Kong team. This role is designed for a technology innovator who thrives on solving complex challenges and is passionate about building AI-driven solutions that transform the Financial Services industry. As an AI Engineer at Capco, you will play a pivotal role in shaping the future of insurance by leveraging cutting-edge AI technologies to deliver intelligent, scalable, and compliant solutions. Your work will enable our clients to unlock new efficiencies, enhance customer experience, and stay ahead in a rapidly evolving digital landscape. If you are excited about applying advanced AI techniques to real-world business problems and driving measurable impact, we want you on our team.

Key Responsibilities

Build multi-agent workflows to optimize business processes within insurance.
Develop and maintain software pipelines for data processing, model training, and deployment using Python-based frameworks.
Train, fine-tune, and optimize neural network models, including LLMs, for specific use cases such as risk assessment and customer query resolution.
Collaborate with data scientists, engineers, and business stakeholders to translate requirements into production-ready AI applications.
Ensure AI models adhere to banking regulations, data privacy standards (e.g., GDPR, CCPA), and ethical AI practices.
Monitor deployed solutions in production, troubleshooting issues, and implement updates as needed.
Strong experience delivering production-grade applications, backend services and technical components that support data, workflow, automation or AI-driven solutions.
Participate in code reviews, agile ceremonies, and CI/CD processes.


Experience And Qualifications

3–12 years of professional experience in AI/ML engineering, with a focus on software development and deployment.
Build and integrate components for LLM, RAG, search, agent-based and automation solutions,
Strong software engineering experience with Python, Java, React Next, Node.js
Hands-on experience training and fine-tuning neural network models, with a track record of optimizing for performance and scalability.
Proven expertise working with LLMs (e.g., GPT, BERT) and building agentic solutions using frameworks like LangChain, LangGraph, or ADK.
Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud) for model deployment and data management.
Solid understanding of machine learning concepts, including supervised/unsupervised learning, evaluation metrics, and bias mitigation.
Experience with version control systems (e.g., Git) and agile methodologies.
Excellent problem-solving skills and ability to work in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.


Preferred Qualifications

Experience in financial services domains 
Familiarity with big data tools (e.g., Spark, Hadoop) and databases (SQL/NoSQL).
Knowledge of graph databases and knowledge graphs.
Understanding DevOps practices, containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), and MLOps workflows.
Publications, open-source contributions, or certifications in AI/ML.
Strong communication skills for presenting technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
